ekspor: United States, China, Japan, Global Fisheries Market
deskripsi: Tual City is positioned as a strategic integrated fish processing hub in Eastern Indonesia. The project is located in Dusun Dumar, South Dullah Island, and supported by Pelabuhan Perikanan Nusantara Tual, 8.0 ha land area, cold storage facilities, capture fisheries fleet, tuna processing, HPI production, live grouper, and ice block production. The project supports sustainable fisheries development and export-oriented fishery processing.
